meaning.why_this_file_matters: Marty is one of the archive's most consequential relationship files because the record changes phase repeatedly: ordinary companion, separate social gravity, conflict mythology, death, then grief and memory.
known: Marty is one of the densest names in the late-2024 Chronicle/social record.
An external obituary fixes the death date at 29 January 2025.
A February 2025 Chronicle corridor processes the death, but many detailed claims inside that retelling still need closer sourcing.
interpretive: Drift King, catalyst, rival and related symbolic labels belong to project/Chronicle interpretation rather than neutral biography.
The file is strongest when it preserves companionship, conflict and grief together instead of choosing one permanent moral label.
unknown: Original Marty–Tim conversations before later labels hardened remain incomplete.
Detailed claims about the final hours and relationship motives require closer primary evidence.
The immediate grief corridor still needs fuller source recovery.
meaning.relationship_arc: ordinary companion / creative-social presence → separate social center and conflict → death → grief, memory and posthumous project interpretation
meaning.confidence_note: High confidence in dense dated presence and the externally corrected death date; mixed confidence in conflict motives and final-hours narratives.
meaning.reader_rule: Read the casebook before the archetype labels: dated scenes and source mode are the documentary spine; roles and symbolic interpretations explain later meaning but do not replace the events.
